name: Shizumi Suzune
source:
With a beautiful, curvy body, Suzune is admired by men and envied by women. She is careful with how she upholds herself, knowing that she is the center of attention in many people’s eyes. However, her true identity is the angel, [url=/c44279]Holy Rouge[/url], who gives [url=/c23093]Yuri[/url] the power to become [url=/c44278]Angeltear[/url]. She keeps her identity hidden to fight against the demons and protect both the holy realm and the human world. Although her fighter persona may come across as cold, her contact with humans is melting her heart gradually.
